type.description: The message name — <name> in the routing key.

domain.description: The owning domain — <domain> in the routing key. Names the role, not the vendor.

kind.description: Which exchange carries this message. Never reaches the routing key.

ts.description: The PUBLISH instant — when this message went out, ISO-8601 UTC. A republish has the same content and a new ts.

target.description: The switcher this message addresses — the <target> routing segment: the switcher's configured name, 'main' by default, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Required on every switcher message.

link.description: The switcher's link: connected, connecting or dropped. Anything but connected means the document holds the last the switcher reported, not live state.

me.description: The M/E — the switcher's own label, numbered from 1 ("ME 1").

source.description: The source on this bus: the switcher's source id, non-negative.

items.description: A source in an enabled box: the switcher's source id, non-negative.

bundled.description: For SuperSource, the sources in its enabled boxes, in box order; for any other source, empty. Only SuperSource is expanded.

program.description: A bus: the source on it, and for SuperSource the sources in its enabled boxes, in box order.

source.description: The source on this bus: the switcher's source id, non-negative.

items.description: A source in an enabled box: the switcher's source id, non-negative.

bundled.description: For SuperSource, the sources in its enabled boxes, in box order; for any other source, empty. Only SuperSource is expanded.

preview.description: A bus: the source on it, and for SuperSource the sources in its enabled boxes, in box order.

inTransition.description: true while the M/E's transition runs. The transition position is not on the wire; this carries what a reader needs.

items.description: One M/E: its program and preview buses, and whether its transition is running.

mixEffects.description: Every M/E, never empty; each numbered from 1.

SwitcherStateChanged.description: The switcher's basic state — every M/E's program and preview buses, whether each M/E's transition is running, and the link. Anything but link connected means the buses are last-known. The whole document, published on every change and as every command's answer.
